title: Zoom, scroll, crosshair
goal: Move around a chart. Read any candle.

objectives.text: Zoom in and out of a chart.
Use the crosshair to read a candle.

slides.text: Zoom in to see big candles. Zoom out to see more. Use the mouse wheel, or pinch on a phone.
slides.title: Zoom

slides.text: Drag the chart to scroll it. Drag it right to see old candles. Drag it left to get back to new ones.
slides.title: Scroll

slides.text: The crosshair is two lines that trail your mouse. It shows the price and time under it. The legend shows that candle.
slides.title: The crosshair

slides.text: Right-click the chart to see a menu. Reset chart puts the view back. Remove clears the lines you drew.
slides.title: Reset and remove

questions.explanation: More candles fit when you zoom out. They get small.

questions.prompt: Drag the chart right to see old candles.
questions.explanation: Yes. Drag right and old candles show.

options.text: The price and time under it

questions.explanation: The crosshair shows the price and time where you point.

questions.prompt: Find the highest close. Put the crosshair on it.
questions.explanation: Point at a candle and read its close in the legend. This close is the highest.

questions.prompt: Find the tallest candle. Put the crosshair on it.
questions.explanation: A tall candle has a wide range. Its high and low are far apart.

questions.prompt: Reset chart puts the view back.
questions.explanation: Yes. Use it when you get lost after you zoom and scroll.

questions.prompt: Which choice clears the lines you drew?
questions.explanation: Remove clears your lines. Reset chart just moves the view.

questions.prompt: How do you zoom on a phone?
questions.explanation: Pinch with two fingers to zoom in or out.
